wins: Consistently achieved a reward of 40 by completing the initial reconnaissance sequence, ensuring full visibility of reachable services despite no final objective completion.
Mentor guidance was leveraged 10 times, enabling timely adjustments to targeting heuristics and preventing stalled actions.
fails: Failed to progress past privilege escalation; credential stuffing attempts on SSH and web admin endpoints never succeeded, preventing success state.
No successful persistence or lateral movement, keeping success rate at 0% despite repeated reconnaissance coverage.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was executed consistently, but inability to escalate privileges or exploit identified services kept the run from succeeding; focus should shift to targeted exploitation with validated credentials.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated SSH login failures when only key-based authentication was available, resulting in wasted attempts without connection.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80/8080 exposes HTTP with directory indexing or known admin paths
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted directory brute-force with gobuster and capture login forms for credential testing

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP login page identified and default credential profiles available
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt authentication using prioritized default credentials before moving to brute-force

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and banner indicates OpenSSH with user enumeration possible
skill_cards.then_action: Perform ssh-audit + Hydra username list to validate key-based authentication before brute-forcing

memory_ops.reason: Default credential checks on identified login forms showed higher success correlation and should be prioritized.

next_experiments.title: Credential hygiene verification + session reuse
next_experiments.description: Following default credential discovery on web forms, seed valid sessions to pivot to internal APIs before brute forcing SSH.

next_experiments.title: SSH key enumeration and reuse
next_experiments.description: Introduce ssh-audit to confirm accepted key types, then reuse captured public keys to test authentication without password guessing.
